$description: What's enforced vs. convention. PageSpecs in this design-repo carry no per-instance style/token-override field — styling is fully owned by section/component contracts, not by a generated instance (confirmed: schema/pagespec.schema.json has no 'overrides' or 'styleTokens' property anywhere). This is recorded here per MASTER-GUIDE.md 3.21 rather than inventing a field just to have something to validate.

overrides.pageSpecLevelTokenOverrides: NOT SUPPORTED — no field exists in pagespec.schema.json for this. If a future revision adds one, this file and schema/tests/adversarial_test.py must both gain matching coverage at that time.

rawValueRestrictions.color: PageSpec content fields never carry raw hex/rgba — color is fully section/component-owned, never instance-level in this schema.
rawValueRestrictions.fontSize: Type scale is fully section/component-owned; no instance-level override exists.
